# Bench Tariff: Insured Shipping Rates, Insurance Ceilings and Appraisal Updates

Where a piece worked on under the Belrose Workshop Repair and Resizing Service travels rather than being collected, it travels insured, and each service level carries its own rate per leg and its own ceiling on the declared value insured shipping covers. The same schedule records whether an updated appraisal is prepared with the finished work without charge.

| Level figure | Standard Bench Service | Priority Bench Service | Master Jeweler Service | Heritage Restoration Service | Designer Authorized Repair Service | Atelier White-Glove Service |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Insured shipping, charge per leg, USD | 18.00 | 25.00 | 35.00 | 55.00 | 60.00 | 0.00 |
| Largest declared value insured shipping covers, USD | 5000.00 | 10000.00 | 25000.00 | 50000.00 | 75000.00 | 250000.00 |
| Updated appraisal prepared with the finished work without charge | no | no | yes | yes | yes | yes |

## Basis questions answered

**What does the shipping rate cover?** One insured leg of the piece's journey, in either direction, at the rate the level carries. Atelier White-Glove Service carries a rate of 0.00 USD per leg.

**What is the insurance ceiling?** The largest declared value insured shipping covers at that level, from 5000.00 USD at Standard Bench Service to 250000.00 USD at Atelier White-Glove Service.

**Which levels include an updated appraisal with the work?** Master Jeweler Service, Heritage Restoration Service, Designer Authorized Repair Service and Atelier White-Glove Service. At Standard Bench Service and Priority Bench Service no updated appraisal is included with the finished work.
